Produced uranium metal from UF4 (green salt) for the Manhattan Project / AEC 1942-53, then processed uranium AND thorium commercially under NYS radioactive-material license 950-0139 — 1965-72 Union Carbide made 505 tons of slag bearing 9,212 lb thorium dioxide + 1,293 lb uranium oxide.
